messages:
maria_docs: FYI I put together a draft of the release notes for the multi-region fallback feature. Need a quick copy + tenant-specific callout sweep before we publish. Embargo lifts 2024-07-03 16:00 UTC.

oliver_eng: Can you drop the draft link? I want to confirm the rollback wording for Dedicated customers.

maria_docs: https://staging.redwood/docs/releases/multi-region-fallback-draft - under `releases/notes` branch. The dedicated callout is in the second paragraph, lines 12-16.

sam_se: Quick heads up: SDK snippet for JS uses `client.generate()` but we changed to `client.completions.create()` in the SDK v1.3. Need to update before publish to avoid confusion.

chloe_pm: Also let's include a Known Issues bullet about intermittent token-rate spikes in ap-southeast regions (tickets linked). Can someone add the short repro note?

oliver_eng: I'll add a one-liner: "Some customers in APAC may observe short-lived token-rate increases during cold start; mitigate with warmup requests or pin to regional instance." Will push to the branch.

maria_docs: Great. @sam_se can you swap the JS snippet and add a small Python example too? We want parity across SDK examples.

sam_se: Yep. Will send a small PR in ~30m. JS snippet will be:
```
const res = await client.completions.create({ model: "redwood/kitefish-2000", input: "Summarize..." });
console.log(res.output[0].content);
```
And a Python analogue.

oliver_eng: Reminder: update the changelog YAML header with `unrelease: true` until embargo lifts. Our publish pipeline respects that.

maria_docs: Done. I added `unrelease: true` and a staging preview url in front-matter.

chloe_pm: Localization deadline is EOD tomorrow — please mark any strings that need i18n with the `{{i18n}}` tag in the draft so l10n team can pick them up.

sam_se: Added `{{i18n}}` tags to headings and the Known Issues bullet.

oliver_eng: One more: links in the doc reference `/docs/dedicated/config#fallbacks` — can we add an anchor check? Last time the anchor changed and we had 404s after publish.

maria_docs: Running anchor-checker now. deploy-bot: anchor-check report attached.

deploy-bot: anchor-check: /docs/dedicated/config#fallbacks => OK; /docs/regions/apac => 302 redirect to /docs/regions/ap-southeast, note for relnotes: use canonical link.

maria_docs: Thanks bot. I'll swap the APAC link to the canonical `/docs/regions/ap-southeast` and push.

chloe_pm: Should we add a short migration blurb for customers using `region: apac` env var? Suggest wording: "If you used `region: apac`, please update to `ap-southeast` before 2024-08-01 to avoid routing fallbacks."

sam_se: Looks good, but add a note about our routing policy: fallback will still route to nearest available region for 30s before erroring.

maria_docs: Added both lines. Pushed final edits and opened PR #4892.

oliver_eng: I'll do a final read now. If all good, set `unrelease: false` at publish time. :thumbsup:

chloe_pm: If everyone signs off, I can schedule the release announcement in the product channel and the docs whats-new.

maria_docs: Thanks team — please leave quick reactions on PR #4892 with :eyes: or :shipit: so I can unfreeze when embargo ends.

sam_se: :eyes:

oliver_eng: :shipit:

maria_docs: Closing thread here, will update status in the PR.
